facts.label: Aluguel de bicicleta
facts.sub: Lojas perto de parques e lagos alugam bicicletas por hora ou por dia. O preço costuma incluir capacete e cadeado, e você assina um formulário.

facts.label: Capacetes
facts.sub: Em muitos estados, o capacete é obrigatório para crianças e recomendado para adultos. Usar o capacete é uma regra de segurança básica em passeios.

pages.title: A bike by the lake · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Saturday morning at a bike shop near a lake in Seattle. Rows of colorful bikes stand outside in the sun. Noah walks in with a map and a smile. He wants to explore the city by bike. A friendly clerk named Ivy greets him. She holds a helmet and a heavy lock.
“Welcome! Which bike do you want?” says Ivy. “A regular bike, please.” says Noah. “Here you go. Do you need a helmet?” says Ivy.

pages.title: A bike by the lake · 3/3
paragraphs: “Can I ride on the sidewalk, and where is the bike path?” says Noah. “No, use the bike path by the lake. Have fun!” says Ivy. Noah puts on the helmet and checks the brakes. He pays ten dollars and signs a small form. Ivy shows him the bike path on the map. He rides slowly along the lake. At five, he returns the bike and the lock. Safe rules make a happy ride.
